# variables-settings.test.tsx run against main's component

# Same file and assertions; only the import, and a mutate() shim for main's saveConfigSection, differ.

# Most failures are behaviour main never had (the page's save bar, Discard, the conflict notice, focus
# after Add/Remove, the empty state). The stale-Undo test saves with Enter, which main also handles,
# so its failure is a real regression: after a save and its refetch, a late click on main's Undo toast
# puts the deleted row back into the saved draft.

   ❯ VariablesSettings — rows (5)
     × shows the stored pairs in order, names left to right and values in their own direction, with no save bar
     × with nothing stored, explains variables and offers Add in an empty state
     × Add, typing, Remove and Undo change only the draft; nothing is sent until Save
     × removing a middle row keeps the neighbours' edits and order, and Undo puts it back in place
     × removing the only row shows the empty state and moves focus to Add
   ❯ VariablesSettings — saving (7)
     × sends the whole list: blank-key rows left out, everything else exactly as typed
     × Discard puts the saved rows back and retires a pending Undo
     × a failed save keeps the draft and its Undo, says so once, and can be retried
     × a completed save retires the Undo: after the refetch, a late click restores nothing
     × a save that left out a blank-key row settles on the stored rows, even when its refetch lands first
     × edits made during the save survive it and stay unsaved; a second save waits its turn
   ❯ VariablesSettings — server changes (5)
     × a different list while dirty keeps the draft whole and asks: Use theirs, or Keep mine
     × a removed row is never restored into rows the server replaced
     × another site starts clean; the first site's Undo and save never reach it
   ❯ VariablesSettings — Enter and Ctrl+S (4)
     × Enter saves through the hidden default button, once, and the bar says Saved
     × sends nothing on Enter while clean, nor for modified or composing Enter
     × Enter during a save starts nothing more
     × Ctrl+S saves and retires a pending Undo like Save
      Tests  18 failed | 3 passed (21)
